reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin for temporarily stashing, restoring, rotating, and deleting plain-text prompts per conversation session.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供按会话暂存、恢复、轮换和删除纯文本提示词的本地工具。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin for locally stashing, restoring, rotating, and deleting plain-text prompts per conversation session.

capabilities: Stores up to 10 plain-text prompt entries per session in browser localStorage
Displays, restores, deletes, and clears stored prompt entries
Reads and updates the current chat input through the host input action API
Reads and writes shortcut settings through the host settings channel
